tagline: The card. The number. The miss.
confidence_key: BET = fire a unit. LEAN = half unit or skip if tight. FADE = posted because every game needs a number; would not fire real money.

NFL: NE/SEA: one-score and +3 were right. Backup safeties did not equal 250 passing yards.
SF/LAR: 49ers +3.5 cashed. We still under-weighted how dead a short-week favorite can look.
CFB: Miami/FAMU: -59.5 cashed. Do not treat that as a license to lay 35+ every Friday.
MLB: PIT/CHC: dog ML and PCA HR both lost in a 12-2 blowout.
COL/DET: under 8 pushed; Greene 3 hits no HR; Valdez 2 Ks.
HOU/TB: Rays ML cashed late; Diaz and Rasmussen props lost.

NFL: Do not assume a backup safety group means 250 passing yards.
Do not captain a short-week road favorite just because the name is bigger.
CFB: Do not lay juice through a Top-25 team on a short week until availability is posted.
Do not treat a 50-point FCS win as a repeatable side.
MLB: Do not live in a 23rd-ranked pen if the starter is out before the fifth.
Do not force a HR on a .118 team book.
